findings.title: Admin API client has no test coverage of auth/timeout/error paths
findings.note: Highest-scored hotspot file (80.0), untested_change_share=1.0, no test file references client-admin.ts. Auth header construction, timeout, and error-swallow-to-null behavior are unguarded; a regression (e.g. wrong header name, timeout dropped) would silently break admin API access.

findings.title: API client silently swallows fetch errors with no test
findings.note: Hotspot score 42.9, untested_change_share=1.0, no mapped test. The empty catch block and the flag-gated betaBanner branch both have no assertions; a change here (e.g. accidentally always returning null, as the empty catch currently does after the try block regardless of success) would go undetected.

findings.title: Checkout flow (legacy/new switch) has no automated test
findings.note: untested_change_share=1.0 and no test references checkout.ts despite it composing cart total, pricing, and formatting behind a feature flag. Blast radius is direct: a regression here affects the checkout output customers/orders depend on, and neither branch (legacy or new) is asserted.

findings.title: Bulk pricing behavior test is skipped
findings.note: The only test that would assert priceOf's bulk-discount behavior is disabled via .skip, so priceOf's pricing logic beyond the zero-sku case runs with no automated guard; a pricing regression would not be caught by the suite.

findings.title: Feature flag lookup (isEnabled) has no direct test
findings.note: untested_change_share=1.0 and no test file references flags.ts directly. isEnabled gates checkout.ts's legacy/new branch and both API clients' behavior, so an unguarded change to the lookup or defaults propagates untested into checkout and API paths.

findings.title: Coverage threshold declared but not enforced by test script
findings.note: coverageThreshold is configured but the "test" script runs plain jest without --coverage, so the threshold is never evaluated during a normal `yarn test`/`npm test` run, letting untested hotspot files (client.ts, client-admin.ts, checkout.ts) go unflagged.
